models.name: Muse Spark Open
models.why: Meta's 816B open-weight MoE needs two 512GB M5 Ultra Mac Studios at 4-bit (~493GB) and Apple's own figure of over 36 tok/s comes from two of them; the trending query turns up the license terms and the 39 AA Intelligence Index score rather than a new benchmark.

engines.hardware: 4x Mac Studio M5 Ultra (unified memory, Thunderbolt 5 + low-latency driver)
engines.quant: 4-bit compressed weights ~493GB; Apple's test figure, 2x M5 Ultra is Meta's minimum; Torch distributed backend for Apple silicon published by Apple's ML research team
